meta.title: Moon Follows Sun
meta.description: The familiar light gradually fades, and we are lost, wandering aimlessly in the dark like moths that have lost their way.

units.rawText: There's a hole punched in my side, but fortunately the wound has been cauterized, preventing my operands and liquid Entropy from leaking out further. Pain radiates from my wound throughout my entire body, but what hurts more is my chest, which no longer has a stake in it. The torn wound is exposed to the air, and it burns like fire.
units.displayText: There's a hole punched in my side, but fortunately the wound has been cauterized, preventing my operands and liquid Entropy from leaking out further. Pain radiates from my wound throughout my entire body, but what hurts more is my chest, which no longer has a stake in it. The torn wound is exposed to the air, and it burns like fire.

spans.text: There's a hole punched in my side, but fortunately the wound has been cauterized, preventing my operands and liquid Entropy from leaking out further. Pain radiates from my wound throughout my entire body, but what hurts more is my chest, which no longer has a stake in it. The torn wound is exposed to the air, and it burns like fire.

units.rawText: Still, this pain is good. It keeps me alert and focused so I don't pass out from the operand loss.
units.displayText: Still, this pain is good. It keeps me alert and focused so I don't pass out from the operand loss.

spans.text: Still, this pain is good. It keeps me alert and focused so I don't pass out from the operand loss.

units.rawText: Crunch!
units.displayText: Crunch!

spans.text: Crunch!

units.rawText: I raise my arm and pry myself from the depression I've made in the wall. Chunks of crushed debris fall around me like rain.
units.displayText: I raise my arm and pry myself from the depression I've made in the wall. Chunks of crushed debris fall around me like rain.

spans.text: I raise my arm and pry myself from the depression I've made in the wall. Chunks of crushed debris fall around me like rain.

units.rawText: As I look down at my hand gripping the hilt of my weapon, I see that my fingertips are starting to turn transparent, indicating that there isn't much left of my life to burn away.
units.displayText: As I look down at my hand gripping the hilt of my weapon, I see that my fingertips are starting to turn transparent, indicating that there isn't much left of my life to burn away.

spans.text: As I look down at my hand gripping the hilt of my weapon, I see that my fingertips are starting to turn transparent, indicating that there isn't much left of my life to burn away.

units.rawText: Withstanding that attack took a lot out of me. My operands... are almost gone...
units.displayText: Withstanding that attack took a lot out of me. My operands... are almost gone...

spans.text: Withstanding that attack took a lot out of me. My operands... are almost gone...

units.rawText: In the rubble, that Persicaria woman holds that Professor in white who just fainted. She looks devastated. I eye them coldly, then tighten my grip on my glaive and approach them.
units.displayText: In the rubble, that Persicaria woman holds that Professor in white who just fainted. She looks devastated. I eye them coldly, then tighten my grip on my glaive and approach them.

spans.text: In the rubble, that Persicaria woman holds that Professor in white who just fainted. She looks devastated. I eye them coldly, then tighten my grip on my glaive and approach them.

units.rawText: Upon seeing me draw close, Persicaria stands in front of the Professor, her hand grasping her sword tightly as she walks shakily towards me.
units.displayText: Upon seeing me draw close, Persicaria stands in front of the Professor, her hand grasping her sword tightly as she walks shakily towards me.

spans.text: Upon seeing me draw close, Persicaria stands in front of the Professor, her hand grasping her sword tightly as she walks shakily towards me.

units.rawText: Your eyes have changed.
units.displayText: Your eyes have changed.

spans.text: Your eyes have changed.

units.rawText: ...The Professor was right. On the battlefield, you are my enemy.
units.displayText: ...The Professor was right. On the battlefield, you are my enemy.

spans.text: ...The Professor was right. On the battlefield, you are my enemy.

units.rawText: And because of my indecision, my hesitation... the Professor was hurt.
units.displayText: And because of my indecision, my hesitation... the Professor was hurt.

spans.text: And because of my indecision, my hesitation... the Professor was hurt.

units.rawText: Well, she isn't hesitating anymore. The only thing in her eyes is certainty. Now, where have I seen that before?
units.displayText: Well, she isn't hesitating anymore. The only thing in her eyes is certainty. Now, where have I seen that before?

spans.text: Well, she isn't hesitating anymore. The only thing in her eyes is certainty. Now, where have I seen that before?

units.rawText: ...I don't remember.
units.displayText: ...I don't remember.

spans.text: ...I don't remember.

units.rawText: This is lame. I don't need to hear about your unwarranted self-importance.
units.displayText: This is lame. I don't need to hear about your unwarranted self-importance.

spans.text: This is lame. I don't need to hear about your unwarranted self-importance.

units.rawText: Clang!
units.displayText: Clang!

spans.text: Clang!

units.rawText: I parry her sword. My gaze flickers between her and the person behind her.
units.displayText: I parry her sword. My gaze flickers between her and the person behind her.

spans.text: I parry her sword. My gaze flickers between her and the person behind her.

units.rawText: Now that the redundant data and the stake have been excised from me, that phantom that plagued me has vanished like it was never there, and these two people that I've been tangling with for a while now have become nothing more than strangers who barged into the Sector.
units.displayText: Now that the redundant data and the stake have been excised from me, that phantom that plagued me has vanished like it was never there, and these two people that I've been tangling with for a while now have become nothing more than strangers who barged into the Sector.

spans.text: Now that the redundant data and the stake have been excised from me, that phantom that plagued me has vanished like it was never there, and these two people that I've been tangling with for a while now have become nothing more than strangers who barged into the Sector.

units.rawText: There shouldn't be anything interfering with me anymore, so why do I feel so—
units.displayText: There shouldn't be anything interfering with me anymore, so why do I feel so—

spans.text: There shouldn't be anything interfering with me anymore, so why do I feel so—

units.rawText: Empty.
units.displayText: Empty.

spans.text: Empty.

units.rawText: Why are you still here? I thought you disappeared with the stake and its chains.
units.displayText: Why are you still here? I thought you disappeared with the stake and its chains.

spans.text: Why are you still here? I thought you disappeared with the stake and its chains.

units.rawText: I was never bound to it in the first place. I'm here because you still hold doubts within your heart.
units.displayText: I was never bound to it in the first place. I'm here because you still hold doubts within your heart.

spans.text: I was never bound to it in the first place. I'm here because you still hold doubts within your heart.

units.rawText: I don't doubt anything.
units.displayText: I don't doubt anything.

spans.text: I don't doubt anything.

units.rawText: Sure, go ahead and lie to yourself; feel free to think you've solved the problem.
units.displayText: Sure, go ahead and lie to yourself; feel free to think you've solved the problem.

spans.text: Sure, go ahead and lie to yourself; feel free to think you've solved the problem.

units.rawText: But the truth is, all you did was throw it aside. You're just pretending not to see it.
units.displayText: But the truth is, all you did was throw it aside. You're just pretending not to see it.

spans.text: But the truth is, all you did was throw it aside. You're just pretending not to see it.

units.rawText: I've got my answer already! I won't be bound by those memories! I'll protect my home and my kin!
units.displayText: I've got my answer already! I won't be bound by those memories! I'll protect my home and my kin!

spans.text: I've got my answer already! I won't be bound by those memories! I'll protect my home and my kin!

units.rawText: No, that's not the answer.
units.displayText: No, that's not the answer.

spans.text: No, that's not the answer.

units.rawText: The shadow frowns, and the corners of her mouth turn down. Her face forms an annoying expression.
units.displayText: The shadow frowns, and the corners of her mouth turn down. Her face forms an annoying expression.

spans.text: The shadow frowns, and the corners of her mouth turn down. Her face forms an annoying expression.

units.rawText: <color=red>—Pity.</color>
units.displayText: —Pity.

spans.text: —Pity.

units.rawText: So you don't even have the courage to face your issues head-on, then?
units.displayText: So you don't even have the courage to face your issues head-on, then?

spans.text: So you don't even have the courage to face your issues head-on, then?

units.rawText: <size=40>...Shut up!</size>
units.displayText: ...Shut up!

spans.text: ...Shut up!

units.rawText: <color=red>What right does she have to pity me?!</color>
units.displayText: What right does she have to pity me?!

spans.text: What right does she have to pity me?!

units.rawText: I know why you're here. It's because those two people are still around, and it's affecting my neural cloud.
units.displayText: I know why you're here. It's because those two people are still around, and it's affecting my neural cloud.

spans.text: I know why you're here. It's because those two people are still around, and it's affecting my neural cloud.

units.rawText: <color=red>Even though you're nothing more than an illusion that's dead and gone.</color>
units.displayText: Even though you're nothing more than an illusion that's dead and gone.

spans.text: Even though you're nothing more than an illusion that's dead and gone.

units.rawText: From the start, they've always treated me like I was you.
units.displayText: From the start, they've always treated me like I was you.

spans.text: From the start, they've always treated me like I was you.

units.rawText: They denied my existence, substituted someone else for me; they're just going off on their own and making me into someone they knew.
units.displayText: They denied my existence, substituted someone else for me; they're just going off on their own and making me into someone they knew.

spans.text: They denied my existence, substituted someone else for me; they're just going off on their own and making me into someone they knew.

units.rawText: Their wish was the fodder for your existence. They made you into a vengeful spirit that won't go away.
units.displayText: Their wish was the fodder for your existence. They made you into a vengeful spirit that won't go away.

spans.text: Their wish was the fodder for your existence. They made you into a vengeful spirit that won't go away.

units.rawText: <color=red>Henceforth, by fire be purged.</color>
units.displayText: Henceforth, by fire be purged.

spans.text: Henceforth, by fire be purged.

units.rawText: <color=red>Burn, burn, burn. Everything must burn. Once it all turns to ashes, there'll be nothing left to stand in my way.</color>
units.displayText: Burn, burn, burn. Everything must burn. Once it all turns to ashes, there'll be nothing left to stand in my way.

spans.text: Burn, burn, burn. Everything must burn. Once it all turns to ashes, there'll be nothing left to stand in my way.

units.rawText: Hey, you—
units.displayText: Hey, you—

spans.text: Hey, you—

units.rawText: Clang!
units.displayText: Clang!

spans.text: Clang!

units.rawText: I don't give that shadow any further chances to deceive me and swing my sword with all my might. A roaring blaze follows in its wake, driving my opponent back and scattering the shadow without a trace.
units.displayText: I don't give that shadow any further chances to deceive me and swing my sword with all my might. A roaring blaze follows in its wake, driving my opponent back and scattering the shadow without a trace.

spans.text: I don't give that shadow any further chances to deceive me and swing my sword with all my might. A roaring blaze follows in its wake, driving my opponent back and scattering the shadow without a trace.

units.rawText: Persicaria is forced to retreat by my might, but she grinds to a halt in front of the Professor; a sign for me to advance further.
units.displayText: Persicaria is forced to retreat by my might, but she grinds to a halt in front of the Professor; a sign for me to advance further.

spans.text: Persicaria is forced to retreat by my might, but she grinds to a halt in front of the Professor; a sign for me to advance further.

units.rawText: Only the victor has the right to dictate history. Once I exterminate you, these worthless strings of redundant data will vanish and everyone will forget the past. Only then... will I be myself.
units.displayText: Only the victor has the right to dictate history. Once I exterminate you, these worthless strings of redundant data will vanish and everyone will forget the past. Only then... will I be myself.

spans.text: Only the victor has the right to dictate history. Once I exterminate you, these worthless strings of redundant data will vanish and everyone will forget the past. Only then... will I be myself.

units.rawText: Burn... Burn until you're nothing but ash...
units.displayText: Burn... Burn until you're nothing but ash...

spans.text: Burn... Burn until you're nothing but ash...

units.rawText: The pink-haired girl before me is frail, but there is no weakness in her eyes. She meets me head-on, as though mocking my determination.
units.displayText: The pink-haired girl before me is frail, but there is no weakness in her eyes. She meets me head-on, as though mocking my determination.

spans.text: The pink-haired girl before me is frail, but there is no weakness in her eyes. She meets me head-on, as though mocking my determination.

units.rawText: <color=orange>...I will not fall.</color>
units.displayText: ...I will not fall.

spans.text: ...I will not fall.

units.rawText: That's right, I can't fall.
units.displayText: That's right, I can't fall.

spans.text: That's right, I can't fall.

units.rawText: My weakness from excessive operand use and the pain of my wounds makes me unsteady on my feet. I grit my teeth and grip my weapon with all my might.
units.displayText: My weakness from excessive operand use and the pain of my wounds makes me unsteady on my feet. I grit my teeth and grip my weapon with all my might.

spans.text: My weakness from excessive operand use and the pain of my wounds makes me unsteady on my feet. I grit my teeth and grip my weapon with all my might.

units.rawText: The Professor is behind me. The entire Oasis is behind me. The hopes of all Magrasea are behind me. Therefore, I cannot allow myself to take another step back.
units.displayText: The Professor is behind me. The entire Oasis is behind me. The hopes of all Magrasea are behind me. Therefore, I cannot allow myself to take another step back.

spans.text: The Professor is behind me. The entire Oasis is behind me. The hopes of all Magrasea are behind me. Therefore, I cannot allow myself to take another step back.

units.rawText: The Professor has entrusted everything to me. Thus, I will fight until we have achieved our shared goal.
units.displayText: The Professor has entrusted everything to me. Thus, I will fight until we have achieved our shared goal.

spans.text: The Professor has entrusted everything to me. Thus, I will fight until we have achieved our shared goal.

units.rawText: I take a step forward, my eyes meeting Sol's with a similar tenacity.
units.displayText: I take a step forward, my eyes meeting Sol's with a similar tenacity.

spans.text: I take a step forward, my eyes meeting Sol's with a similar tenacity.

units.rawText: It can't be helped, then.
units.displayText: It can't be helped, then.

spans.text: It can't be helped, then.

units.rawText: Sol's body hums faintly and then the fire around her swells out, turning the entire Watchtower into a sea of flames, shrouding the world in a curtain of red.
units.displayText: Sol's body hums faintly and then the fire around her swells out, turning the entire Watchtower into a sea of flames, shrouding the world in a curtain of red.

spans.text: Sol's body hums faintly and then the fire around her swells out, turning the entire Watchtower into a sea of flames, shrouding the world in a curtain of red.

units.rawText: You and the Professor taught me this: a warrior fights to the last drop of blood!
units.displayText: You and the Professor taught me this: a warrior fights to the last drop of blood!

spans.text: You and the Professor taught me this: a warrior fights to the last drop of blood!

units.rawText: I will destroy you, even if I have to burn up every last operand to do it!
units.displayText: I will destroy you, even if I have to burn up every last operand to do it!

spans.text: I will destroy you, even if I have to burn up every last operand to do it!

units.rawText: The blonde girl raises her sharp glaive and thrusts it forward, the murderous hatred in her eyes evident to all.
units.displayText: The blonde girl raises her sharp glaive and thrusts it forward, the murderous hatred in her eyes evident to all.

spans.text: The blonde girl raises her sharp glaive and thrusts it forward, the murderous hatred in her eyes evident to all.

units.rawText: Clang, clang, clang!
units.displayText: Clang, clang, clang!

spans.text: Clang, clang, clang!

units.rawText: I grit my teeth and block her thrusts. Sol's attack speed and targeting are different from before. Her strikes are vicious, with every flash of her blade aiming for my vitals.
units.displayText: I grit my teeth and block her thrusts. Sol's attack speed and targeting are different from before. Her strikes are vicious, with every flash of her blade aiming for my vitals.

spans.text: I grit my teeth and block her thrusts. Sol's attack speed and targeting are different from before. Her strikes are vicious, with every flash of her blade aiming for my vitals.

units.rawText: Hng!
units.displayText: Hng!

spans.text: Hng!

units.rawText: Keeping up with the intense exchange of blows is hard enough, but what really hurts is the look in her eyes.
units.displayText: Keeping up with the intense exchange of blows is hard enough, but what really hurts is the look in her eyes.

spans.text: Keeping up with the intense exchange of blows is hard enough, but what really hurts is the look in her eyes.

units.rawText: (This is... the look of someone who gazes upon their mortal enemy.)
units.displayText: This is... the look of someone who gazes upon their mortal enemy.

spans.text: This is... the look of someone who gazes upon their mortal enemy.

units.rawText: Clang!
units.displayText: Clang!

spans.text: Clang!

units.rawText: The flaming glaive comes at me from a tricky angle, and I barely manage to deflect it.
units.displayText: The flaming glaive comes at me from a tricky angle, and I barely manage to deflect it.

spans.text: The flaming glaive comes at me from a tricky angle, and I barely manage to deflect it.

units.rawText: (Pants heavily) Your moves have changed.
units.displayText: (Pants heavily) Your moves have changed.

spans.text: (Pants heavily) Your moves have changed.

units.rawText: Sol's technique has changed from before; no longer does she strike with an unwavering directness. Now, every move she makes is both sinister and unpredictable.
units.displayText: Sol's technique has changed from before; no longer does she strike with an unwavering directness. Now, every move she makes is both sinister and unpredictable.

spans.text: Sol's technique has changed from before; no longer does she strike with an unwavering directness. Now, every move she makes is both sinister and unpredictable.

units.rawText: That's right, this is who I am.
units.displayText: That's right, this is who I am.

spans.text: That's right, this is who I am.

units.rawText: I was born an Entropic, and I fight for the Entropy.
units.displayText: I was born an Entropic, and I fight for the Entropy.

spans.text: I was born an Entropic, and I fight for the Entropy.

units.rawText: I'll crush you all with my very own moves.
units.displayText: I'll crush you all with my very own moves.

spans.text: I'll crush you all with my very own moves.

units.rawText: Urgh!
units.displayText: Urgh!

spans.text: Urgh!

units.rawText: I can't handle this at all! The flaming afterimage of her weapon lashes at me, leaving countless wounds on my body.
units.displayText: I can't handle this at all! The flaming afterimage of her weapon lashes at me, leaving countless wounds on my body.

spans.text: I can't handle this at all! The flaming afterimage of her weapon lashes at me, leaving countless wounds on my body.

units.rawText: (Her speed is on a completely different level, and I can't dodge her attacks...)
units.displayText: Her speed is on a completely different level, and I can't dodge her attacks...

spans.text: Her speed is on a completely different level, and I can't dodge her attacks...

units.rawText: (At this rate, I'll be forced on the back foot... I won't be able to defend at all, much less counterattack...)
units.displayText: At this rate, I'll be forced on the back foot... I won't be able to defend at all, much less counterattack...

spans.text: At this rate, I'll be forced on the back foot... I won't be able to defend at all, much less counterattack...

units.rawText: (...If I can't evade, then I'll meet it head-on! But I need to create an opportunity for myself...)
units.displayText: ...If I can't evade, then I'll meet it head-on! But I need to create an opportunity for myself...

spans.text: ...If I can't evade, then I'll meet it head-on! But I need to create an opportunity for myself...

units.rawText: Where are you looking?!
units.displayText: Where are you looking?!

spans.text: Where are you looking?!

units.rawText: The glaive comes at me again, but I don't try to dodge it. Instead, I run right into it.
units.displayText: The glaive comes at me again, but I don't try to dodge it. Instead, I run right into it.

spans.text: The glaive comes at me again, but I don't try to dodge it. Instead, I run right into it.

units.rawText: Splurch!
units.displayText: Splurch!

spans.text: Splurch!

units.rawText: The blade penetrates my body, and my vision is obscured by a cold sweat. I grunt heavily, then force myself forward, driving the blade deeper into me.
units.displayText: The blade penetrates my body, and my vision is obscured by a cold sweat. I grunt heavily, then force myself forward, driving the blade deeper into me.

spans.text: The blade penetrates my body, and my vision is obscured by a cold sweat. I grunt heavily, then force myself forward, driving the blade deeper into me.

units.rawText: Ack—Uuuuurrrrgghhh...
units.displayText: Ack—Uuuuurrrrgghhh...

spans.text: Ack—Uuuuurrrrgghhh...

units.rawText: What the?!
units.displayText: What the?!

spans.text: What the?!

units.rawText: Warning, neural strain index at 92%. Frame damage at 45%. Data damage at 32%. Neural strain maximum reached...
units.displayText: Warning, neural strain index at 92%. Frame damage at 45%. Data damage at 32%. Neural strain maximum reached...

spans.text: Warning, neural strain index at 92%. Frame damage at 45%. Data damage at 32%. Neural strain maximum reached...

units.rawText: The pain is so great that I black out for a moment, but I bite the inside of my cheek to force myself to stay awake. I keep one hand on the glaive so she can't just pull it out while the other reaches into my coat.
units.displayText: The pain is so great that I black out for a moment, but I bite the inside of my cheek to force myself to stay awake. I keep one hand on the glaive so she can't just pull it out while the other reaches into my coat.

spans.text: The pain is so great that I black out for a moment, but I bite the inside of my cheek to force myself to stay awake. I keep one hand on the glaive so she can't just pull it out while the other reaches into my coat.

units.rawText: My fingers make contact with a cold, metallic object. As I bite back the pain in my shoulders, my hands whip out like lightning.
units.displayText: My fingers make contact with a cold, metallic object. As I bite back the pain in my shoulders, my hands whip out like lightning.

spans.text: My fingers make contact with a cold, metallic object. As I bite back the pain in my shoulders, my hands whip out like lightning.

units.rawText: How about... this?!
units.displayText: How about... this?!

spans.text: How about... this?!

units.rawText: Clack!
units.displayText: Clack!

spans.text: Clack!

units.rawText: A metallic Entropization suppressor fastens itself around Sol's neck.
units.displayText: A metallic Entropization suppressor fastens itself around Sol's neck.

spans.text: A metallic Entropization suppressor fastens itself around Sol's neck.

units.rawText: Hng?!
units.displayText: Hng?!

spans.text: Hng?!

units.rawText: Sol claws at her neck and hesitates for a moment.
units.displayText: Sol claws at her neck and hesitates for a moment.

spans.text: Sol claws at her neck and hesitates for a moment.

units.rawText: An Entropization suppressor...
units.displayText: An Entropization suppressor...

spans.text: An Entropization suppressor...

units.rawText: Are you kidding me?
units.displayText: Are you kidding me?

spans.text: Are you kidding me?

units.rawText: She rips it off her neck and tosses it aside like garbage.
units.displayText: She rips it off her neck and tosses it aside like garbage.

spans.text: She rips it off her neck and tosses it aside like garbage.

units.rawText: That stuff only works on agents who haven't been Entropized. I was born an Entropic. What did you even expect it to do to me?
units.displayText: That stuff only works on agents who haven't been Entropized. I was born an Entropic. What did you even expect it to do to me?

spans.text: That stuff only works on agents who haven't been Entropized. I was
born
an Entropic. What did you even expect it to do to me?

units.rawText: You can't stop me, so give up.
units.displayText: You can't stop me, so give up.

spans.text: You can't stop me, so give up.

units.rawText: Having seen through my intentions, Sol pulls her glaive free.
units.displayText: Having seen through my intentions, Sol pulls her glaive free.

spans.text: Having seen through my intentions, Sol pulls her glaive free.

units.rawText: I should have known... this would happen...
units.displayText: I should have known... this would happen...

spans.text: I should have known... this would happen...

units.rawText: Take a good look at her. She is your enemy.
units.displayText: Take a good look at her. She is your enemy.

spans.text: Take a good look at her. She is your enemy.

units.rawText: This is Sol's choice. If she's chosen to stand against you, it only follows that you should treat her as an enemy.
units.displayText: This is Sol's choice. If she's chosen to stand against you, it only follows that you should treat her as an enemy.

spans.text: This is Sol's choice. If she's chosen to stand against you, it only follows that you should treat her as an enemy.

units.rawText: We can't wager our lives and those of others because we pity an enemy and want to wake them up.
units.displayText: We can't wager our lives and those of others because we pity an enemy and want to wake them up.

spans.text: We can't wager our lives and those of others because we pity an enemy and want to wake them up.

units.rawText: The Professor's right... It's high time I woke up.
units.displayText: The Professor's right... It's high time I woke up.

spans.text: The Professor's right... It's high time I woke up.

units.rawText: You're not Sol... the real Sol would always stand by our side no matter what kind of crisis we faced.
units.displayText: You're not Sol... the real Sol would always stand by our side no matter what kind of crisis we faced.

spans.text: You're not Sol... the real Sol would always stand by our side no matter what kind of crisis we faced.

units.rawText: She would never drive us into a corner like this!
units.displayText: She would never drive us into a corner like this!

spans.text: She would never drive us into a corner like this!

units.rawText: As though in response to my determination, Arvak and Alsvid hum in my hands, and they burst into golden flames—the color of Sol.
units.displayText: As though in response to my determination, Arvak and Alsvid hum in my hands, and they burst into golden flames—the color of Sol.

spans.text: As though in response to my determination, Arvak and Alsvid hum in my hands, and they burst into golden flames—the color of Sol.

units.rawText: ...We, who have always bathed under the sunlight fear the night; the darkness it brings. As the shadows grow longer and dread begins to reign, we know not of what to do.
units.displayText: ...We, who have always bathed under the sunlight fear the night; the darkness it brings. As the shadows grow longer and dread begins to reign, we know not of what to do.

spans.text: ...We, who have always bathed under the sunlight fear the night; the darkness it brings. As the shadows grow longer and dread begins to reign, we know not of what to do.

units.rawText: All we can do is to pray, with all of our hearts, for the sun to rise again.
units.displayText: All we can do is to pray, with all of our hearts, for the sun to rise again.

spans.text: All we can do is to pray, with all of our hearts, for the sun to rise again.

units.rawText: My voice is a little hoarse. The tears that flow silently from the corner of my eyes meet the heat of the flames that surround me, and are promptly vaporized.
units.displayText: My voice is a little hoarse. The tears that flow silently from the corner of my eyes meet the heat of the flames that surround me, and are promptly vaporized.

spans.text: My voice is a little hoarse. The tears that flow silently from the corner of my eyes meet the heat of the flames that surround me, and are promptly vaporized.

units.rawText: You were right... it was us who were living in the past... hoping for some kind of miracle...
units.displayText: You were right... it was us who were living in the past... hoping for some kind of miracle...

spans.text: You were right... it was us who were living in the past... hoping for some kind of miracle...

units.rawText: Thinking about how good it would be if all that had never happened, if Sol was still around.
units.displayText: Thinking about how good it would be if all that had never happened, if Sol was still around.

spans.text: Thinking about how good it would be if all that had never happened, if Sol was still around.

units.rawText: It's true... there's no way the dead would return for no reason. To wait and hope is nothing more than trying to cope with this loss.
units.displayText: It's true... there's no way the dead would return for no reason. To wait and hope is nothing more than trying to cope with this loss.

spans.text: It's true... there's no way the dead would return for no reason. To wait and hope is nothing more than trying to cope with this loss.

units.rawText: When the night comes and the sun sets, when she no longer watches over the weak, there is only one thing I can do...
units.displayText: When the night comes and the sun sets, when she no longer watches over the weak, there is only one thing I can do...

spans.text: When the night comes and the sun sets, when she no longer watches over the weak, there is only one thing I can do...

units.rawText: And that is to take up these swords with determination, shape this little hope of ours into a bright future with my own two hands!
units.displayText: And that is to take up these swords with determination, shape this little hope of ours into a bright future with my own two hands!

spans.text: And that is to take up these swords with determination, shape this little hope of ours into a bright future with my own two hands!

units.rawText: Shaping even the dimmest hope into the brightest future... Persicaria, that's what you've dedicated yourself to all this time.
units.displayText: Shaping even the dimmest hope into the brightest future... Persicaria, that's what you've dedicated yourself to all this time.

spans.text: Shaping even the dimmest hope into the brightest future... Persicaria, that's what you've dedicated yourself to all this time.

units.rawText: The swords in my hands reflect my countenance back at me—that of a determined warrior.
units.displayText: The swords in my hands reflect my countenance back at me—that of a determined warrior.

spans.text: The swords in my hands reflect my countenance back at me—that of a determined warrior.

units.rawText: They point at my enemy, who grows more and more frustrated.
units.displayText: They point at my enemy, who grows more and more frustrated.

spans.text: They point at my enemy, who grows more and more frustrated.

units.rawText: Like you said, your sun has set, so just let go and embrace reality.
units.displayText: Like you said, your sun has set, so just let go and embrace reality.

spans.text: Like you said, your sun has set, so just let go and embrace reality.

units.rawText: Even if the sun has set, I will bring her back no matter the cost.
units.displayText: Even if the sun has set, I will bring her back no matter the cost.

spans.text: Even if the sun has set, I will bring her back no matter the cost.

units.rawText: <size=40><color=orange>To the last drop of blood!</color></size>
units.displayText: To the last drop of blood!

spans.text: To the last drop of blood!

units.rawText: The light fades, and the smoke clears. Only the scent of ashes remains in the air.
units.displayText: The light fades, and the smoke clears. Only the scent of ashes remains in the air.

spans.text: The light fades, and the smoke clears. Only the scent of ashes remains in the air.
